tools.Name: Hermes Agent
tools.Description: A self-improving AI agent with a built-in learning loop that creates and improves skills from experience, persists knowledge, and automates multi-step workflows.
tools.Use_Case: Automating complex, multi-step tasks across terminal, browser, and messaging platforms (Telegram, Discord, Slack) with autonomous skill creation.

tools.Name: VoiceStudio
tools.Description: A fully-local, open-source alternative to cloud-based voice services, supporting voice cloning, design, video dubbing, and transcription.
tools.Use_Case: Cloning voices and producing high-quality audio or dubbing videos locally on your own hardware without API keys or subscriptions.

tools.Name: Graphify
tools.Description: Transforms entire codebases and their associated documentation, PDFs, and config files into a queryable knowledge graph using tree-sitter AST and LLM semantic passes.
tools.Use_Case: Querying codebase relationships, tracing dependencies, and explaining complex architectural concepts instead of using standard text-search (grep) tools.
